policy.name: Uttar Pradesh Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Promotion Policy - 2022
policy.order_no: Government Order dated 28.09.2022 (Dept. of MSME & Export Promotion); GO number not printed on the English translation

zones.MP: Madhyanchal and Paschimanchal regions (Gautam Buddha Nagar and Ghaziabad are in Paschimanchal; they differ only for stamp duty)

zone_lookup: Bundelkhand (BP) is the Jhansi division (Jhansi, Jalaun, Lalitpur) and the Chitrakoot division (Banda, Chitrakoot, Hamirpur, Mahoba). Gautam Buddha Nagar and Ghaziabad (Meerut division) are Paschimanchal (MP). The MSME Policy 2022 does not list which divisions form Purvanchal, Madhyanchal and Paschimanchal; check with your DIC for other districts.

schemes.name: Investment Promotion Assistance (capital subsidy) on fixed capital investment
schemes.notes: Applies to new MSMEs. Expansion/diversification units get the same facilities if gross block AND production capacity both rise by at least 25% (para 5.8.2). The base is plant, machinery, equipment and related building; land is excluded. The building component is limited to 10% of fixed capital investment (para 4). P&M includes captive/non-conventional power, pollution control plant, water purification, DG sets and boilers (para 4). SC/ST/women entrepreneurs (at least 51% share) get +2 percentage points (para 5.2.4.2/5.3.5.3). Paid in 2 equal instalments: the first on partial progress (e.g. building completion), the second at 50% commercial production. Total assistance under the policy cannot exceed the fixed capital investment (para 5.3.8). Eligible investment period from the date of application: micro 2 years, small 3, medium 4; commercial production must start within it (para 7.3). Only one policy may be used per benefit head (para 7.4). Excluded: tobacco/pan masala, alcohol/aerated drinks, firecrackers, plastic carry bags under 40 micron (para 7.7).

schemes.name: Capital interest subsidy for new micro enterprises
schemes.notes: rate is 50% OF THE INTEREST paid, not percentage points of the loan. The cap is Rs 25 lakh per unit over 5 years; there is no separate annual cap. SC/ST/women units (at least 51% share) get 60%. Claimed annually after the interest is fully paid. Land cost is excluded from the loan base. New micro units only.

schemes.name: Quality certification reimbursement (ZED, WHO-GMP, Hallmark, BIS/NABCB-accredited certifications)
schemes.clause: Para 5.5.3 (table, row 'Cost of certification or approval, cost of certification or approval by third party testing')
schemes.notes: The cap is Rs 5 lakh for all sizes. Other rows of the same table use the same rates (75/50/25%): testing lab setup, equipment and calibration capped at Rs 5 lakh; IT system acquisition at Rs 2 lakh; mandatory employee qualification/training at Rs 0.5 lakh.

schemes.name: Clean production technology / pollution control equipment reimbursement
schemes.notes: Covers 40% of P&M spending on clean production (raw material substitution, water/energy economy, pollution control equipment), up to Rs 20 lakh. Para 5.9.8: existing units are eligible; new units that install pollution control at commissioning get IPA under 5.3.4 instead. Related items: ZLD equipment at 50% up to Rs 75 lakh (5.9.2); green/energy/water audit fee at 75% up to Rs 50,000 plus recommended equipment at 50% up to Rs 20 lakh (5.9.5); environment management lab at 50% up to Rs 10 lakh (5.9.7).

other_benefits: Stamp duty exemption: 100% in Purvanchal & Bundelkhand; 75% in Madhyanchal & Paschimanchal except Gautam Buddha Nagar and Ghaziabad (50%); 100% for women entrepreneurs anywhere (para 5.3.3)
CGTMSE one-time guarantee fee borne by the state for collateral-free loans up to Rs 2 crore (para 5.3.2)
100% reimbursement of the employer's EPF share for 5 years for new MSMEs (para 5.4.1)
SME IPO / stock exchange fund raising: 20% of expenses, max Rs 5 lakh (para 5.3.6)
Mandi fee waiver for 5 years for new food processing units with P&M of Rs 5 crore or more (para 5.3.7)
Patent/GI: 75% of documentation cost up to Rs 10 lakh, plus attorney fee up to Rs 50,000 (national) / Rs 2 lakh (international) (para 5.5.5)
ERP: 75% up to Rs 1 lakh; ICT: 75% up to Rs 5 lakh (para 5.5.6)
IGBC green rating consultancy: 50% up to Rs 2.5 lakh (para 5.9.6)
Private MSME parks/flatted factories: 50% interest reimbursement up to Rs 2 crore/year for 7 years, plus 100% stamp duty on land (para 5.1.6)
CETP/common infrastructure: 50% up to Rs 10 crore; common boiler: up to Rs 50 lakh (para 5.9.1, 5.9.3)
unverifiable: No SGST reimbursement, electricity duty exemption or per-unit power tariff subsidy for MSMEs exists in the MSME Policy 2022. It states that incentives are de-linked from net GST (Invest UP highlights). These may exist for larger units under the UP Industrial Investment & Employment Promotion Policy 2022, which is outside this MSME scheme.
District-to-region mapping (Purvanchal/Madhyanchal/Paschimanchal) is not annexed in the MSME policy or IIEPP 2022, and no official district list was found.
The GO number of the 28.09.2022 Hindi order was not found. The source is the official English translation, which says the Hindi version prevails.

Validity is 5 years from promulgation or until a new policy (para 7.2); valid_to 2027-09-27 is derived from this. No replacement MSME policy notified before 2026-10-17 was found. An ICAI handbook (secondary) mentions a 'UP MSME Policy 2025-2030', but no official document for it was found.
Operational rules/GOs (niyamavali) for IPA and interest subsidy, which may add conditions, were not reviewed.

18-10-2026: the client supplied the official list of UP's 18 revenue divisions and their districts (up.gov.in); it confirms the Bundelkhand districts but does not assign divisions to Purvanchal/Madhyanchal/Paschimanchal.
